[Verse 1]
[Bb]Boys workin' on empty [Cm]Is
[Bb]that the kind'a way to face the burning heat? [Cm]
[Bb]I just think about my baby [Cm]I'm
[Bb]so full of love I could barely eat [Cm]
[Bb]There's nothing sweeter than my baby [Cm]I'd
[Bb]never want once from the cherry tree [Cm]
[Bb]'Cause my baby's sweet as can [Cm]be She
[Bb]give me toothaches just from kissin' me

[Chorus]
[Gm]When my [F]time comes around
[Bb]Lay me gently in the cold dark [Cm]earth
[Gm]No grave can [F]hold my body down
[Bb]I'll crawl home to her

[Verse 2]
[Bb]Boys when my baby found me [Cm]
[Bb]I was three days on a drunken sin [Cm]
[Bb]I woke with her walls around me [Cm]
[Bb]Nothin' in her room but an empty crib [Cm]
[Bb]And I was burnin' up a fever [Cm]I
[Bb]didn't care much how long I lived [Cm]
[Bb]But I swear I thought I dreamed her [Cm]She
[Bb]never asked me once about the wrong I did

[Bb]My baby never fret none [Cm]A-
[Bb]bout what my hands and my body done [Cm]
[Bb]If the lord don't forgive me [Cm]I'd
[Bb]still have my baby and my babe would have me [Cm]
[Bb]When I was kissing on my baby [Cm]And
[Bb]she put her love down soft and sweet [Cm]
[Bb]In the low lamp light I was [Cm]free Hea-
[Bb]ven and hell were words to me
